title: CrowdStrike reports Q4 revenue up 23% YoY to $1.31B, vs. $1.30B est., a profit of $38.7M, compared with a loss of $86.3M a year earlier (Katherine Hamilton/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Katherine Hamilton / Wall Street Journal: CrowdStrike reports Q4 revenue up 23% YoY to $1.31B, vs. $1.30B est., a profit of $38.7M, compared with a loss of $86.3M a year earlier — The cybersecurity company posted a profit of $38.7 million, or 15 cents a share, compared with a loss of $86.3 million, or 35 cents a share, a year earlier
